title: Horizontal coordinate range
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as an interval, such as (-√3 R/3, 0].

title: Time range
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as an interval, such as [2R/c, 4√3 R/(3c)).

title: Apply Snell's law
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the modified Snell's law for negative index, using |n| = sin(i)/sin(r).

title: Identify critical angle
description: Important: The solution must identify the critical refraction angle r_c = arcsin(1/|n|) = 30° that determines the exit limit.

title: Calculate optical path
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the shortest (R) and longest (R/cos(30°)) geometric paths inside the material.

title: Relate speed and index
description: Important: The solution must correctly state the speed in the medium as v = c/|n| = c/2.

title: Coordinate from geometry
description: Optional: The solution may show the geometric derivation of the exit point's x-coordinate as x = -R tan(r).

title: Sign error in coordinate
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the horizontal coordinate range is given with an incorrect sign or includes positive values.

title: Ignore absolute value
description: Pitfall: Penalize if Snell's law is applied using n = -2 directly without taking the absolute value for angles.
